the laparoscopic approach is not yet the method of choice in the surgical therapy of insulinomas.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the laparoscopic removal is not the method of choice in insulinoma surgery.
laparoscopy is an alternative to open surgery, but not a standard procedure.
in case of solitary insulinoma, the intraoperative detection is reliable and therefore preoperative localizing procedures are not necessary.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in case of an untraced adenoma, preoperative localizing procedures are not necessary.
in spite of the high rate of postoperative complications, the surgical treatment of organic hyperinsulism is the method of choice.
the surgical therapy of insulinoma is still a challenge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the intraoperative detection is more important than the preoperative localisation diagnostics, especially in the case of solitary adenomas.
the surgical removal of solitary adenoma is possible with high reliability and low complication rate by intraoperative methods without preoperative localizing procedures.
the intraoperative detection of the tumor is the main prerequisite of the success.
